name: crossbyte
description: Cross-platform Haxe runtime and networking framework for event-driven applications and services: TCP, WebSocket, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, reliable UDP, WebRTC data channels with STUN/TURN NAT traversal, IPC, RPC, and systems tools.
releasenote: 1.0.1: HTTP requests answered from any thread, request bodies streamed or held to a memory limit, Socket.bind before connect, media types for audio and video, and fixes across HTTP, TCP, RPC, data and the platforms.
